subject: Urgent: Pricing triage to protect Q2 forecast — RDCloud SOW
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing triage: RDCloud SOW discount approval needed to keep Q2 commit

Team —

Heads-up on a time-sensitive ask from R&D Cloud (contact: Lauren Pierce). They're finalizing the SOW but are pushing hard on price. If we don't grant the requested concession they say they'll need to re-evaluate the start date and could slip beyond Q2. That would remove ~$350k of committed ARR from our Q2 forecast.

Quick facts:
- Opportunity: RDCloud — new enterprise deal, 12-month subscription + onboarding services
- Current list: $1,200,000 ARR (annualized)
- Requested concession: 15% across base subscription for year 1
- Documents attached: discount_summary.xlsx (has margin impact), I will upload SOW after Lauren signs off the redlines.

Asks:
1) Karthik — can Deal Desk review and either approve a limited concession or propose an alternative (credit for services, extended T&Cs) by EOD Friday? This is critical for sales commit.
2) Jordan — if Deal Desk needs more time, can Finance model a conservative fallback (mark as at-risk) so our forecast doesn't overstate Q2? We need the impact in time for Friday's forecast refresh.

If Deal Desk approves on a conditional basis (DocuSign + Net-30), Sales will execute immediately. Please advise next steps.

Thanks —
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing triage: RDCloud SOW discount approval needed to keep Q2 commit

Vanessa —

Thanks for the details. I reviewed the discount_summary.xlsx you attached. A few quick notes and requests before I can sign off:

1) Need formal justification memo from Sales (one paragraph) that explains commercial reasons for the concession and alternatives you tried (list of POIs/upsell mechanics considered).
2) We require a clean SOW (latest redlines in PDF) and the proposed final signature counterparty (full legal name).
3) Confirm billing terms and whether procurement requested any SLA/SOC concessions.

Margins at -15% materially change the unit economics on this footprint. If Sales can provide a path to expand within 12 months (commit to an expansion milestone) we can approve a time-limited discount tied to those milestones. Otherwise we'll consider non-discount options (implementation credits, deferred onboarding fees).

Assuming we get the memo + SOW today, I can issue a conditional approval by EOD Fri. If not, we need to treat the opportunity as "at-risk" in the forecast.

-Karthik
Director, Deal Desk

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 13:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing triage: RDCloud SOW discount approval needed to keep Q2 commit

Karthik —

Attached: RDCloud_SOW_v3.pdf (latest redlines from Lauren), and I updated discount_summary.xlsx with expected expansion cadence. One-paragraph justification below and pasted into the Doc: 

"RDCloud is a strategic landing for our platform into the engineering tools market. Their early adoption and high integration needs create a runway for additional scope (observability connectors + fine-tuned prompt templates) after year 1. Granting a limited, milestone-tied concession will preserve the Q2 start and enable a committed expansion motion we can quantify in Q3."

Procurement requested standard SLA language only — no changes to SOC or data residency. Billing requested Net-30 and a POC invoice for onboarding (we can accept). Full legal name: R&D Cloud LLC. Point of contact: Lauren Pierce <lpierce@rdcloud.com>.

Jordan — can Finance sketch a conservative scenario (mark $350k as at-risk) if we don't have approval by Friday COB? If Deal Desk approves with conditions, Sales will require a quick DocuSign turnaround.

-Vanessa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing triage: RDCloud SOW discount approval needed to keep Q2 commit

Vanessa / Karthik —

Thanks for the updates. Two quick items from Finance:

1) For the forecast refresh: if we don't have an explicit Deal Desk approval by Friday COB, model this opportunity as 0% committed and move the $350k from "committed" to "best case". That will keep our headline forecast conservative.
2) If Deal Desk issues a conditional approval (DocuSign + payment term commitments), Finance will accept a provisional "commit" but we need a note in the deal record listing the conditions and a follow-up checkpoint in 30 days.

Please give me the final margin impact if Karthik confirms the -15% conditional approval. I'll then update the forecast sheets and flag the change for FP&A.

-Jordan
Director, Revenue Finance

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing triage: RDCloud SOW discount approval needed to keep Q2 commit

Team —

Approved (conditional): Deal Desk will approve a 15% discount on base subscription for year 1 under these conditions:
- Signed DocuSign executed by R&D Cloud LLC
- Net-30 payment terms accepted in DocuSign
- One expansion milestone: additional +20% ARR committed in writing within 12 months or discount is void on renewal

I've uploaded an approval memo to the HubSpot deal and attached the signed snippet (internal approval). Vanessa, please confirm when DocuSign is sent and cc finance at signing so Jordan can toggle the commit status.

Next steps:
- Vanessa: send DocuSign and push for signature today.
- Jordan: if signature occurs, mark $350k as committed per conditional approval and add the conditional note to the deal record.
- Markus: legal to review SOW appendix for milestone language (cc'd).

-Karthik
Director, Deal Desk
